INSERT INTO crm_account_assignments (
            organization_id,
            account_source_id,
            crm_principal_id,
            role,
            latest_raw_record_id,
            synced_at
         )
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, 'PRIMARY_OWNER', $4, COALESCE($5, now()))
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, account_source_id, role)
         DO UPDATE
            SET crm_principal_id = EXCLUDED.crm_principal_id,
                latest_raw_record_id = EXCLUDED.latest_raw_record_id,
                synced_at = EXCLUDED.synced_at,
                updated_at = now()
